title: 第001章 他真的承受不起第002章 前进吧学神
lines: 大明历650年，江东省，江州理工大学校园外，苏恒迈步走向校园时，路边突然冲出一道身影，拉出一道炽烈的拳影砸在苏恒腹部。
一拳，苏恒就痛的失去了所有力气，浑身皮肤像被烧红了一样发热发烫，在他强忍着痛苦运转木神功时，身影才嗤笑着呸了一口，“苏恒，我替许少来问候你，不要在网上折腾了，这次是给你个小教训，下次，下次就是断胳膊断腿，或陪你那短命的死鬼老爹一起完蛋了，明白么？”
“你不怕？啧啧，那你母亲呢？你想下次见面，你母亲和你爹一样躺在病床上生死不知么？”
“我大明帝国200多亿子民，每天意外或事故死亡的并不在少数，记住我，我叫杜欢，不要让我再来找你，否则就是你的死期！”
一连串阴森的话语后，杜欢吸一口香烟，对着苏恒正面吹了一口烟雾，才嚣张的大笑离去。
苏恒死死盯着远去的背影，他皮肤依旧像煮熟了的大虾，痛苦的厉害，但他没有发出一丝声音，咬着牙默默不语。
几分钟后，木神功在体内运转多遍，苏恒身体恢复一些，才忍着痛苦继续走向学校宿舍。
江州理工灵木系大一宿舍楼701，等苏恒刚走进房间，就失去所有力气噗通一声瘫软在了地板上，这一刻，他差点哭出声来，不是因为疼，是他极度痛恨自己的没用。
父亲苏震前些日子因为一次意外，得罪了老家县城许家、许少某个小妾，就被那个许少恶毒的派人殴打致残，还因为送医不及时，至今昏迷不醒，医生说若没有足够档次的灵药治疗，恐怕会长期植物人状态。
正在江州理工读大一的苏恒听闻这消息，如遭雷击，立刻和学校请了假赶回老家。
但许家在他老家县城是超级豪门，不要小视一县之地的土豪，大明200多亿子民，平均一下每县都有上千万人，苏恒老家是人口大县，有三四千万人，其中的豪门影响力惊人，若不是顾忌苏恒是一个二本进化高校高材生的身份，苏家现在情况会更惨。
他在老家寻求公义无果，就开始在网上发帖，希望把事情公布出去引来社会关注，期望以民意逼迫老家的官方做事，惩罚许家承担法律责任，赔付父亲的医药费，可他才在网上炒起了一点名气，就引来了许家的报复？
刚才杜欢的一拳只是警告性质，但苏恒确定若自己继续，以许家的底蕴，真下定决心做一件事，哪怕他是江州理工在校生，也会莫名其妙的遭遇大意外。
死亡不可怕，苏恒悲伤的是，父母辛辛苦苦把自己拉扯大，在父亲近植物人状态，母亲悲伤过度一夜白了小半头黑发时，自己再意外死亡，对她又会是多么大的打击？？
许家，许家？！！
苏恒双目发红、呼吸都越来越压抑时，一侧木质地板上突然有一株藤蔓植物，灵蛇一样伸展来一条茎叶，叶片自动拂过苏恒面庞，给他体内注入一股暖流，让他情绪略略平复一些。
这个宿舍是一间古风古韵的木质建筑，建筑内到处都是藤蔓植物或不知名花草，天然小树生长成桌椅形状，还有一些桌椅旁的植物散发温暖柔和的光芒，照亮空间。
两个藤蔓组成的吊网，犹如吊床一样悬在宿舍两侧。
灵木系的建筑格局，大多是如此，这些植物也都是有灵性的。
苏恒惨笑一声，抓着叶片贴在自己脸上，“你也感受到了么？我真没用！”

就在这时，一阵手机铃声响起，苏恒抓起来一看才发现是母亲的电话，接听后，对面立刻传来一道崩溃焦急的声音，“小恒，小恒？你没事吧，你千万不能出事，许家又派人来警告我让你老实点，小恒，我求你了，求求你了，你爸已经那样了，就算昏迷不醒他也还活着，等你哪天成了强者，就有机会治好他，你别做傻事，我们惹不起啊，我真的好怕，他们威胁我说你再在网上炒作会把你也……我好怕连你也失去，小恒答应我，答应妈妈，这辈子妈妈第一次求你，千万别做傻事，我们就这样算了好不好？”
等母亲哭声越来愈大，语气里的哀求意味越来越重，苏恒也急了，语气在无法维持平静，“妈，我没事，我不会再那样了。我答应你一定好好学习出人头地，一定会在以后治好我爸，让他醒过来的。”
从小把他拉扯大的母亲，哭着哀求他一件事，他承受不起。
他真承受不起！！
这一刻苏恒左手紧握，不长的指甲深深刺入掌心嫩肉，血流弥漫时，他却感觉不到一丝疼痛。
勉强维持着冷静，苏恒安慰母亲几句，对着天道发誓自己再也不做那些傻事了，他才挂掉电话走进洗手间，右手一拳砸在坚硬的木质洗涮台边，一拳又一拳，砸的自己右手血肉模糊。
片刻后，看着镜子里一张帅气飞扬的白净面庞，这是一张足以让任何女性尖叫的帅气脸庞，搭配一米九的身高，19岁青春飞扬的年纪，放在上一辈子的地球，恐怕会成为最红火的小鲜肉流量明星吧。
可是，帅有屁用？！
苏恒愤怒的想杀人，不过渐渐冷静几分，他又对着镜子露出一抹惨笑，“还有比我更惨的重生者么？虽然和上辈子的父母，不是同样的人，但我从婴儿期就有完整的灵智记忆。”
“上辈子，父母把我拉扯到24岁大学毕业，刚工作几个月一次车祸就死的不能再死！白白让他们伤心一场，悲伤余生！”
“平行世界，重生在平行世界，十九年养育之恩，却要母亲哭着求我和我对话，苏恒，苏恒……你枉为人子！”
惨笑着对镜子低语，越说越激动，苏恒再次用血肉模糊的手掌砸向洗涮台，嘭的一声，手背露出森森白骨时，他才感觉到大脑一阵晕眩，有了晕厥的趋势。
身体上的刺痛远不及心伤的百分之一，苏恒在巨大的情绪波动中，再次给了自己一拳才昏迷过去。
“叮，检测到宿主灵魂力达标，超级学神系统正式开启，……”
苏恒昏迷那一刻，脑海中才闪过一道奇异声音，同一时间，洗手间外隶属于苏恒的吊床，一张张网状藤蔓灵蛇一样散开，伸展出一根修长的藤茎进入洗手间，藤茎顶部一朵鲜花以肉眼可见速度绽放，洒出一滴滴花露滴落苏恒血肉模糊的右手。
content_en:
In the year 650 of the Ming Dynasty, in Jiangdong Province, outside the campus of Jiangzhou University of Science and Technology, Su Heng was walking towards the campus when a figure suddenly rushed out from the roadside and pulled out a fiery fist and hit Su Heng in the abdomen.
With one punch, Su Heng lost all his strength in pain, and the skin all over his body felt as hot as if it had been burned red. When he endured the pain and used the Mu Shen Gong, the figure sneered and took a sip, "Su Heng, I'm here to greet you on behalf of Mr. Xu. Don't bother on the Internet. This time I will teach you a little lesson. Next time, next time, I will break my arms and legs, or I will end up with your short-lived dead ghost father. Do you understand?"
"Aren't you afraid? Tsk, what about your mother? Do you think that next time we meet, your mother will be lying on the hospital bed like your father, not knowing whether to live or die?"
"There are more than 20 billion people in the Ming Empire. There are not a few who die in accidents every day. Remember me, my name is Du Huan. Don't let me come to you again, otherwise it will be your death!"
After a series of gloomy words, Du Huan took a puff of cigarette, blew a puff of smoke in front of Su Heng, and then left with an arrogant laugh.
Su Heng stared at the retreating figure. His skin was still like a cooked prawn and the pain was severe, but he did not make a sound and gritted his teeth in silence.
After a few minutes, the Mu Shen Gong was circulated in the body many times. Su Heng's body recovered a little, and then he endured the pain and continued to walk to the school dormitory.
No. 701, the freshman dormitory of the Lingmu Department of Jiangzhou University of Technology. As soon as Su Heng entered the room, he lost all his strength and collapsed on the floor. At this moment, he almost cried, not because of pain, but because he hated his own uselessness.
Due to an accident a few days ago, his father, Su Zhen, offended a concubine of the Xu family in his hometown county, and was beaten and disabled by Xu Shao's vicious men. He was also in a coma because he was not sent to the hospital in time. The doctor said that if there is not enough elixir treatment, he may be in a long-term vegetative state.
When Su Heng, a freshman at Jiangzhou Institute of Technology, heard the news, he immediately asked for leave from school and rushed back to his hometown as if he had been struck by lightning.
But the Xu family is a super wealthy family in his hometown county. Don't underestimate the local tycoons in one county. There are more than 20 billion people in the Ming Dynasty. On average, there are tens of millions of people in each county. Su Heng's hometown is a populous county with 30 to 40 million people. The influence of the wealthy families is amazing. If it were not for Su Heng's status as a top student in a second-level evolutionary college, the Su family's current situation would be even worse.
He sought justice in his hometown to no avail, so he started posting online, hoping to publicize the matter and attract social attention. He hoped to use public opinion to force the officials in his hometown to do something, punish the Xu family to take legal responsibility, and pay for his father's medical expenses. But he had just gained a little fame on the Internet, and he attracted revenge from the Xu family?
Du Huan's punch just now was just a warning, but Su Heng was sure that if he continued, with the Xu family's background and his determination to do something, even if he was a student at Jiangzhou University of Technology, he would encounter a big accident inexplicably.
Death is not scary. What makes Su Heng sad is that her parents worked hard to raise her up. When her father was in a near-vegetative state and her mother was so sad that half of her black hair turned gray overnight, how big a blow would it be to her if she died unexpectedly? ?
Xu family, Xu family? ! !
When Su Heng's eyes turned red and his breathing became more and more depressed, a vine suddenly appeared on the wooden floor on one side. It stretched out a stem and leaves like a spiritual snake. The leaves automatically brushed Su Heng's face, injecting a warm current into his body and calming his mood slightly.
This dormitory is an ancient wooden building. There are vines or unknown flowers and plants everywhere in the building. Small natural trees grow into the shape of tables and chairs. There are also some plants beside the tables and chairs that emit warm and soft light, illuminating the space.
A hanging net composed of two vines hangs like a hammock on both sides of the dormitory.
Most of the architectural patterns of the spiritual wood system are like this, and these plants are also spiritual.
Su Heng laughed miserably and held the leaf against his face, "Did you feel it too? I'm so useless!"
At this moment, a cell phone rang. Su Heng grabbed it and found out that it was his mother's call. After answering, a broken and anxious voice came from the other side, "Xiao Heng, Xiao Heng? Are you okay? You must not get into trouble. The Xu family sent someone to warn me to be honest. Xiao Heng, I beg you, please, your dad has already done that, even if he is unconscious, He is still alive when he wakes up. When you become a strong man one day, you will have a chance to cure him. Don't do stupid things. We can't afford to offend you. I'm really scared. They threatened me that if you continue to hype up on the Internet, you will also...I'm so scared that I will lose you too. Xiao Heng promised me, promised mom. For the first time in this life, mom begs you, don't do stupid things. Let's just forget it, okay? "
When the mother's crying became louder and louder, and the pleading in her tone became heavier and heavier, Su Heng became anxious and couldn't keep his tone calm, "Mom, I'm fine, I won't do that again. I promise you will study hard to get ahead, and you will definitely cure my dad and let him wake up in the future."
His mother, who had raised him since childhood, cried and begged him for something that he couldn't bear.
He couldn't bear it! !
At this moment, Su Heng clenched his left hand tightly, and his short nails dug deeply into the tender flesh of his palm. Although blood flowed everywhere, he felt no pain at all.
Barely maintaining his composure, Su Heng comforted his mother with a few words and swore to God that he would never do those stupid things again. Then he hung up the phone and walked into the bathroom. He punched the side of the hard wooden sink with his right hand, punching him again and again, leaving his right hand bloody and bloody.
After a while, I looked at a handsome and fair face in the mirror. This is a handsome face that can make any woman scream. With a height of 1.9 meters and a youthful and vigorous age of 19 years old, in the last lifetime of the earth, I am afraid he will become the most popular young celebrity.
But, is being handsome useless? !
Su Heng was so angry that he wanted to kill someone, but he gradually calmed down a little. He smiled sadly in the mirror, "Are there any reborn people who are worse off than me? Although I am not the same person as my parents in my previous life, I have had complete spiritual memory since I was a baby."
"In my last life, my parents kept me until I graduated from college at the age of 24. I died in a car accident just a few months after I started working! I made them sad for nothing and will be sad for the rest of my life!"
"Parallel world, rebirth in a parallel world, nineteen years of nurturing, but my mother is crying and begging me to talk to me, Su Heng, Su Heng... you are not the son of a human being!"
Smiling miserably and whispering to the mirror, becoming more and more excited as he spoke, Su Heng once again hit the sink with his bloody palm. With a bang, when the back of his hand was exposed with white bones, he felt a dizziness in his brain and a tendency to faint.
The stinging pain on his body was far less than one percent of the pain in his heart. Su Heng, in the midst of huge emotional fluctuations, punched himself again before passing out.
"Ding, it has been detected that the host's soul power has reached the standard, and the super god of learning system is officially activated..."
…
The moment Su Heng fell into coma, a strange sound flashed in his mind. At the same time, outside the bathroom, on the hammock belonging to Su Heng, net-shaped vines spread out like snakes, stretching out a slender cane and entering the bathroom. A flower on the top of the cane bloomed at a speed visible to the naked eye, spilling drops of flower dew onto Su Heng's bloody right hand.
title_en: Chapter 001 He really can’t bear it Chapter 002 Go ahead, learn the god
